reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically sound, correctly linking dwell time to atomic mobility and phase selection, though it assumes a liquid-like droplet state and neglects possible solid-state diffusion pathways.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined variable (dwell time) and decisive falsification criterion, though precise control of dwell time at such extreme heating rates may be challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a central challenge in HEA nanoparticle synthesis and provides a testable, mechanistic framework that would guide experimental design.
